name: Bernkastel
source:
Bernkastel hates losing and is willing to use everything in order to win.
She knows that in this game, her status as a witch means nothing. Therefore, she created an alliance - the 'Bern Alliance'.
Bernkastel likes to play the part of the leader most of the time. She has a short temper which can be controlled as long as her team wins.
